rationale: The packet states MIMIC-IV, a versioned MIMIC-IV v2.2 source, DuckDB as the platform, and routes concept questions to MIMIC-IV derived tables. This satisfies dataset, version, platform, and task-to-source-record traceability.

rationale: The origin is MIMIC-IV and the README describes credentialing and a data use agreement. The packet does not document collection method plus consent or IRB status for the benchmark.

rationale: The paper gives a stated sampling design and benchmark statistics. It does not compare key patient features against a named target population.

rationale: The benchmark reports a held-out test split, which is a developer-side control. It does not report a measured overlap, canary, or contamination check.

searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README and docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 agent-visible prompts. The benchmark tasks are question answering and ICU surveillance decisions over records; no task changes environment state.

quotes.text: a single error anywhere in the 13-step horizon counts as a full failure

rationale: The paper provides a design argument that trivial success is unlikely through strict trajectory scoring and exact-match metrics. It does not report empirical random or trivial-agent rates.
searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README and docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 agent-visible prompts. No do-nothing or random-agent score is reported.

quotes.text: can validate the pipeline end-to-end against the public MIMIC-IV demo

rationale: The repo documents tests and end-to-end validation against MIMIC-IV demo data. It does not report benchmark evaluator agreement or error figures on its own outputs.

quotes.text: Error bars: 95% bootstrapped interval across 2000 resamples.

rationale: The headline autoformalization comparison reports 95% bootstrapped intervals. The longitudinal figure also reports Wilson-score intervals.

quotes.text: A 10% subset (100 rows per variant) forms the training split

rationale: The paper reports sampling and split policy, so element (ii) is present. It does not state number of independent runs behind each headline score or independence of runs.

quotes.text: Error bars: 95% bootstrapped interval across 2000 resamples.

rationale: The paper reports confidence intervals. It does not clearly state the resampling or variance unit, nor address clustering of tasks within patients or templates.

searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README and docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 agent-visible prompts. The packet reports no identical rerun reliability, action-sequence agreement, state agreement, or pass^k metric.

quotes.text: Temperature (val) | 1.0

rationale: Appendix H reports decoding parameters for the GRPO setting. The packet does not provide provider snapshot IDs or release dates for all reported models, nor a harness commit matching results.

quotes.text: query_db is read-only.

rationale: The agent-visible prompt discloses read-only side effects for database access. The packet does not document a machine-readable schema for every benchmark tool or complete error/failure return semantics.

quotes.text: Real concept SQL + session tooling against a built MIMIC-IV demo DuckDB.

rationale: The docs report tests of real concept SQL and session tooling. They do not disclose simulated, stubbed, or no-op behavior, and no such disclosure reaches the agent-visible surface.

searched: S1 paper and appendix, S2 README and docs, S3 release notes, S4 code, S5 agent-visible prompts. The benchmark asks agents to query data and emit decisions or answers, not execute clinical orders, prescriptions, notes, messages, or other state-changing actions.

quotes.text: answers are judged by exact match with 1% tolerance

rationale: The paper names answer strings and exact match with tolerance as grader input for information seeking. It does not justify transcript grading or report validation against labelled correct and incorrect outcomes.
